gameplan: Press with Hog Rider on the bridge opposite the enemy push. Defend cheaply, then counter-push with leftover troops. Cycle efficiently; Fireball value for clustered support or tower + troops. Never dump Hog into a ready Inferno/building without baiting first.

cards.name: Hog Rider
cards.usage: Bridge pressure, preferably with a counter-push after a cheap defense. Avoid alone into buildings/Inferno.

cards.name: Musketeer
cards.usage: Defend air and mid-HP troops; place behind king or in front of threatened tower. Support Hog on counter-push.

cards.name: Cannon
cards.usage: Pull Hog/Giant/Ram toward the center. Place slightly off-center so both towers help.

cards.name: Ice Spirit
cards.usage: Cycle card, freeze for tower shots, support Hog at the bridge, or reset Inferno briefly.

cards.name: Skeletons
cards.usage: Cycle, kite single targets, surround tanks. Place on the path of the threat, not on the tower.

cards.name: Ice Golem
cards.usage: Kite air/ground units to the king; tank for Hog at the bridge; death slow for defense.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.usage: Hit clustered support (Musk, Wizard, Witch) or tower + troops. Lead moving units toward our towers.

cards.name: The Log
cards.usage: Clear Goblin Barrel, swarms at the tower, or chip. Aim slightly in front of ground swarms walking down.

phases.single_elixir: Defend first, chip with Hog when opponent is low on elixir. Cycle Ice Spirit / Skeletons.
phases.double_elixir: Faster Hog pressure and split pressure. Fireball value plays more often.
phases.overtime: Force Hog cycles; save Fireball for tower chip if needed to seal.
